turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Utlämningen, Uma på Orvendin Cars Stockholm. Hur kan jag hjälpa dig?
turns.translation: Collection desk, Uma at Orvendin Cars Stockholm. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hej Uma, jag är Bahns digitala assistent och ringer om order CD-420442, Bentley Continental GT. Vår förare Kasper åker inte förrän säljaren har hävt betalningsspärren, så kan ni säga till Bahn så fort Johan Ekwall hävt den?
turns.translation: Hi Uma, I'm Bahn's digital assistant calling about order CD-420442, the Bentley Continental GT. Our driver Kasper won't set off until the seller has lifted the payment hold, so could you tell Bahn as soon as Johan Ekwall has lifted it?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Hej! Just nu ligger spärren kvar, för fakturan är obetald och ingen undertecknad fullmakt har kommit. Efter kontrollen klockan 15 mejlar vi Bahn om spärren är hävd, så skicka ingen förare innan ni hört från oss.
turns.translation: Hi! Right now the hold remains, since the invoice is unpaid and no signed release has arrived. After the 15:00 check we'll e-mail Bahn whether the hold is lifted, so don't send a driver before you've heard from us.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tack, då förstår jag. Kasper väntar alltså tills ni mejlat Bahn efter kontrollen klockan 15 att spärren är hävd. Tack för hjälpen, hej då!
turns.translation: Thanks, then I understand. So Kasper waits until you have emailed Bahn after the 3 PM check that the hold is lifted. Thanks for your help, goodbye!

steps.name: resolve_without_person

steps.content:
The gig for order CD-420442 is on hold. Kasper has confirmed he is on standby. Uma at Orvendin's collection desk said the payment hold is still on, because the invoice is unpaid and no signed release document has arrived. She agreed that Kasper waits for Orvendin's e-mail after the 15:00 check before he travels.

I scheduled a callback for 15:15 Stockholm time. If the e-mail has not arrived by then, I will call the collection desk again.

decision.why: Sofie talked it through with the agent: Orvendin checks payments at 10:00 and 15:00, so Kasper waits for the collection desk's word before he travels, as Aino held the gig on the Ferrari.

lesson.text: Orvendin Cars Stockholm: when the seller has put a hold on the car, hold the driver until the seller lifts the hold. Sofie decided so.
